Rammus

Jungle Pure meme

AP Rammus Jungle (OK)

How to play this build

Roll in with Powerball (Q) to engage and pop Defensive Ball Curse (W) to reflect damage; on AP, the Tremors ult plus Spikes deal real damage while you're near-indestructible. Taunt (E) the enemy carry to lock it down.

Skill order

Max priority:

Q Bola Rodante → W Postura Defensiva → E Provocar

The ultimate (R) is always leveled at 6, 11 and 16.

Level 123456789101112131415161718
Q QQQQQ
W WWWWW
E EEEEE
R RRR
Why this order
Powerball (Q) for engage speed and impact damage; Defensive Ball (W) second for the reflect. E (taunt) at 1 point.

Items and what they do

  1. Sunfire Cape Health and armor; aura that constantly burns nearby enemies.
  2. Rabadon's Deathcap The biggest AP item in the game: multiplies your total AP.
  3. Rylai's Crystal Scepter AP and health; your spells slow enemies (helps land everything).
  4. Thornmail Armor; reflects damage back at auto-attackers.
  5. Sorcerer's Shoes Boots with magic penetration.

Masteries: how they work

In Season 3 you have up to 30 points (at level 30) to split across three trees: Offense (damage), Defense (durability) and Utility (mana, cooldown reduction and mobility). The notation 21/0/9 means 21 points in Offense, 0 in Defense and 9 in Utility.

Masteries
0/21/9 — Defense
Why this page
0/21/9 goes defense: you're the tank engager, the AP is a troll bonus.
